s.en: Put a passphrase into gpg-agent's cache

o.en: Preset a passphrase. This is what you usually will use. gpg-preset-passphrase will then read the passphrase from stdin.
Flush the passphrase for the given cache ID from the cache.
Instead of reading the passphrase from stdin, use the supplied string as passphrase. Note that this makes the passphrase visible for other users.
